snippet.title: Regarding Sasha FULL Game Walkthrough / Playthrough - Let's Play (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
Regarding Sasha By Ellen Kůtová, Fofonos, mishikuk, Jacqueline Koch All Endings Horror Game Part 1 to Ending [Microsoft Windows]

Sasha leads a quiet, love-filled life, cherishing each day with her child. But her peaceful routine is suddenly disrupted. Unsettling memories from the past begin to resurface, and Sasha’s perfect world starts to crack. Strange visits. Unanswered questions. A growing sense of something being wrong...

Regarding Sasha: https://elllleonor.itch.io/regarding-sasha
Developer: Ellen Kůtová, Fofonos, mishikuk, Jacqueline Koch
Genres: Horror
Platforms: Microsoft Windows
